description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mampe, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521202 (22/0868)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, property details, and legal encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership registration and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
